identity_bridge: NorthC page 'Datacenter Münchenstein (Basel) 1' (JSON-LD datePublished 2022-07-18, dateModified 2026-10-23): 'Adresse: Weidenstrasse 41, 4142 Münchenstein (Basel)'; total area 3,500 m2; total power 6 MW; designed to Tier III; linked by a high-speed backbone to NorthC's Biel (Bern) and Winterthur (Zürich) data centres.

NorthC post of 30 September 2026: NorthC operates its Swiss data-centre network; its four carrier- and cloud-neutral data centres in Münchenstein, Biel and Winterthur are equipped for customers' IT requirements. NorthC's Swiss menu lists Münchenstein (Basel) 1, Münchenstein (Basel) 2, Biel (Bern) and Winterthur (Zürich) as its four existing Swiss data centres, plus the planned Münchenstein (Basel) 3 and Genf.

The federal search returns one official address for Weidenstrasse 41 4142 Münchenstein (EGAID 101865685) linked to GWR EGID 245060063: an existing (status 1004) non-residential building of class 1220, built 2014, 1,428 m2 footprint, 3 storeys, designated 'Tesla Rechenzentrum', on parcel 6620 (EGRID CH298272714956). Sub-addresses 41a and 41b on the same parcel are designated 'Rechenzentrum Tesla' and 41c 'Generatorengebäude 2' (2025).
